\section{Method}\label{sec:method}
The objective maximises the expected return
\begin{equation}\label{eq:objective}
  J(\theta) = \mathbb{E}_{\tau \sim \pi_\theta}\left[\sum_{t=0}^{T} \gamma^t r_t\right]
\end{equation}
as in Equation~\ref{eq:objective}, following~\cite{schulman2017ppo}.
Section~\ref{sec:missing} does not exist, and neither does~\cite{nobody2020}.
